accesRefuse: This page is reserved for stock management (admin, manager, stock manager).
aucunStockEnMain: No sales rep currently has stock on hand.
erreurCommercialDepot: Select a sales rep and a warehouse.
reconciliationTitre: Quick check of this issue (issued / returned / sold)
ecartDetecte: ⚠️ Discrepancy detected: the number of missing units (issued − returned) doesn't match the sales recorded that day for this sales rep. Needs review.

echanges.aide: The sales rep brings back damaged products and leaves with good ones. Their stock is unchanged; damaged goods enter the warehouse in a 'damaged' batch.

controleRapideAide: This quick check compares, for this issue only, what is missing at return with recorded sales. It creates no debt or entry: to handle a gap officially, prepare the reconciliation sheet.

colonnes.aideQuantite: In hand (bold) / received from the warehouse on the current round (grey), restocks included.

demandes.aideFormulaire: Say what you need for your route. The stock manager receives your request and prepares the release.
demandes.commentairePlaceholder: e.g. Large order expected at a customer
demandes.motifPlaceholder: e.g. Not enough oil in stock, restock Thursday
demandes.motifPartielObligatoire: Enter a reason: you are not granting everything requested.
demandes.aideTraitement: Granting directly creates the stock release to the rep. Enter 0 for a product you cannot supply.

ia.aide: AI looks at your route, the stock recorded at your customers, their usual purchases, your recent sales and what you already carry. You can change everything before sending.
ia.erreur: The AI proposal failed, try again or enter your request.
ia.vide: AI has nothing to propose: enter your request yourself.
ia.basePortefeuille: No route that day: based on your {{n}} customers.

arbitrage.aide: AI compares the request with warehouse stock, other pending requests, undelivered customer orders, what the rep already carries and their recent unsold returns.
arbitrage.erreur: The AI suggestion failed: try again or decide yourself.
